title: WPMS/1175/2013 of Umed Ram Vs D.m. Nainital

paras.text:
CLMA No.8300/2013 (Delay Condonation Appl.)
CLMA No.8308/2013 (Delay Condonation Appl.)
In
WPMS No.1175 of 2013
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
Mrs. Anjali Noliyal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. R.C. Arya, Standing Counsel for the
State.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Delay condonation applications are
allowed and the delay in filing the counter
affidavit as well as supplementary counter
affidavit is condoned. Counter affidavit as well
as supplementary counter affidavit is taken
on record.
This petition has been filed by the
petitioner challenging the order dated
08.05.2013, by which the District Magistrate,
Nainital, by fixing the monthly rent @
` 6052.50, asked the petitioner to deposit
` 24, 210/-, as rent, from April, 2013 to July,
2013.
The petitioner approached this Court
and submitted that since his house is under
construction, he will vacate the official
accommodation before 31.07.2013. Learned
counsel for the petitioner submitted that in
the order impugned, the area has wrongly
been mentioned as 403.5 square feet,
whereas the actual area, which has been
allotted to the petitioner as his residence, is
297.89 square feet. This fact has also been
stated in the supplementary affidavit filed on
behalf of the petitioner.
Considering the submission of the
learned counsel for the petitioner, this Court,
on 31.05.2013, directed the petitioner to
deposit ` 17,873/- (Rupees Seventeen
Thousand Eight Hundred & Seventy Three

only) within a period of one month from that
day.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submitted that the petitioner complied the
order dated 31.05.2013 and now, the
petitioner has vacated the official
accommodation in question.
Considering all these facts and
considering the fact that the petitioner has
complied the order dated 31.05.2013 and has
deposited the amount of ` 17,873/- (Rupees
Seventeen Thousand Eight Hundred &
Seventy Three only) and further considering
the fact that the petitioner is a retired
employee, I quash the order dated 08.05.2013
passed by the respondent.
With the observation made above, the
writ petition is disposed of finally.
No order as to costs.
